scripts.verify: npm run check:runtime && npm run check && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run secrets && npm run test:emulators && npm run test:browser
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run release:check --workspace=@job-search/server
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-job-search --only auth,firestore,storage "npm run test:integration --workspace=@job-search/server"
